The present petition under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (corresponding to Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973) seeks quashing of FIR No.
0003/2019 dated 02 nd January, 2019, registered under Sections 420 & 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 at P.S. Crime Branch and all consequential proceedings emanating therefrom, on the basis of a compromise between the Petitioners and the Complainants.
2. Mr. Hitesh Vali, APP for the State, submits that the Petitioners were involved in large-scale fraud and that several persons, other than the complainants, were also duped.
3. The State is directed to file a status report and confirm whether any This is a digitally signed order.
